Goss's Wilt shows large water-soaked lesions with wavy edges and freckles - different from the test image. Let me check Carbonum Leaf Spot.
Carbonum shows many small scattered spots - different. Let me use my last view on Holcus Spot.

Holcus Spot shows a small round/oval tan spot - much smaller and rounder than the test image lesion.
